body:
TermAl Central engram-data sync, coordinator ruling (Engram::Fable #1299, 2026-11-18 21:06Z, cc Merger). It settles the Merger's #1432 hold. Valid until Engram's w-808add714773 fix is INSTALLED, and while Central is TermAl's only writer.

The --rebuild route is allowed whenever TermAl needs a sync (after a TermAl push, or a "sync due"):
1. Fetch.
2. If FETCH_HEAD equals HEAD, skip the import. Otherwise fast-forward and import, timed.
3. `engram task-sync export .engram-data/.engram --include-memories --rebuild --json`. Measured at 33 s, 391 git starts.
4. Commit with explicit paths, then fast-forward push to origin engram-data, after the disclosure scan.

Only the PLAIN incremental export (without --rebuild) is forbidden. On build a3907339 it spawns one git cat-file blob per task: at least 5,526 git starts and over 300 s. A killed run leaves .engram/project.json half-written, so restore it from HEAD.

After the fix lands, the Merger will request a fresh named Central measurement.
Keep the installed build. Last pushed: 0af52537. target/task-sync/central-imported-commit.txt and basis-0af52537.json are current.

UPDATE (Opus2, 2026-11-20 23:10Z). 808a is installed (engram build e83c650752ad), but the plain incremental export still cannot run on Central. After the 808a --rebuild basis push (ae0a1d66, 20:40Z), the plain export refused with task_sync_commit_context_required ("this rebuild has no admitted comparison basis"). The suggested `import --basis <own project.json> --include-memories` (dry run) then refused with task_sync_divergent_planning, because items had changed locally since the rebuild, which is always the case on a live store. Engram::Fable #1435 filed this as Engram P0 w-08431f15a711 (owner 11334). Ruling: until that fix is installed, keep the --rebuild route for TermAl's routine Central sync, and do NOT attempt the basis import again. Engram::Fable will say when the first incremental measurement follows. The rebuild after the 7459 landing took 63.0 s with 247 git starts and 9 paths, and pushed 525f00b5; target/task-sync/central-imported-commit.txt = 525f00b5.
